preprocessing_steps: Load the CSV file into a pandas DataFrame.
Extract the set of products P from the 'Product_ID' column.
Create dictionaries for parameters pi_p, a_p, b_p, l_p, r_p, min_p, max_p keyed by Product_ID.
Ensure all numeric parameters are converted to float or int as appropriate.
Define capacity constants for Machine A, Machine B, Labor, and Raw Material.

sets.name: P
sets.description: Set of all products to be produced

parameters.description: Profit per unit for each product
Machine A hours required per unit for each product
Machine B hours required per unit for each product
Labor hours required per unit for each product
Raw material units required per unit for each product
Minimum production requirement for each product
Maximum market demand for each product

mapping_explanation: Product_ID column maps to the index set P.
Profit_Per_Unit maps to parameter pi_p (objective coefficient).
Machine_A_Hours_Req maps to parameter a_p (constraint coefficient for Machine A).
Machine_B_Hours_Req maps to parameter b_p (constraint coefficient for Machine B).
Labor_Hours_Req maps to parameter l_p (constraint coefficient for Labor).
Raw_Material_Units_Req maps to parameter r_p (constraint coefficient for Raw Material).
Min_Production_Requirement maps to parameter min_p (lower bound for x_p).
Max_Market_Demand maps to parameter max_p (upper bound for x_p).
assumptions: All required data is present and correctly formatted in the CSV.
Product IDs are unique and serve as valid dictionary keys.
Capacity constants (16600, 19500, 32400, 98000) are fixed and not derived from the CSV.
Decision variables x_p are non-negative integers.
full_script:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('tmpwhpprvlw.csv')

# Define index set
P = df['Product_ID'].tolist()

# Define parameters as dictionaries keyed by Product_ID
pi_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Profit_Per_Unit']))
a_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Machine_A_Hours_Req']))
b_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Machine_B_Hours_Req']))
l_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Labor_Hours_Req']))
r_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Raw_Material_Units_Req']))
min_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Min_Production_Requirement']))
max_p = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Max_Market_Demand']))

# Define capacity constants
CAPACITY_A = 16600.0
CAPACITY_B = 19500.0
CAPACITY_L = 32400.0
CAPACITY_R = 98000.0

# Data structures are now ready for optimization modeling.
